name: Combat Hall v1 — Exterior vs Tutorial Island reference
subtitle: Gabled drill hall, taller pyramid-roofed drill tower with helm finial, covered practice yard on posts, half-octagonal armoury apse
review_note: Four roof masses give the hall the most varied silhouette on the ridge: the cross-axis gable with a crossed-swords crest, the tower stepping up over the cavern stair, the open yard reading as a working space rather than a shed, and the apse behind. Fieldstone, timber bays, fitted doors and shuttered slits keep the family. Held below 9.0: the yard posts are plain, the tower pyramid courses are flat slabs, and the apse is only glimpsed from the road side.
improve: Add a carved lintel and hanging shields to the yard posts, stagger the pyramid courses, and give the apse a small round window with a sword-and-shield tracery.
